PRODUCTS.name: Mr. Muscle Multi-Surface Cleaner
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 7-8. Avoid contact with eyes. Rinse surfaces after cleaning.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Spray directly on surface and wipe with damp cloth. No rinsing required for most surfaces. Test on inconspicuous area first.

PRODUCTS.name: Vim Kitchen Degreaser
PRODUCTS.description: Kitchen Degreaser cleaning product - professional grade
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 11-12. Wear gloves. Avoid contact with food surfaces. Rinse thoroughly after use.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Dilute 1 part with 5 parts warm water. Apply to greasy surfaces, let sit 2-3 minutes, scrub and rinse. For tough grease, apply undiluted.

PRODUCTS.name: Pril Kitchen Cleaner & Degreaser
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 10-11. Wear gloves. Food-safe after rinsing. Keep sealed.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Dilute 1 part with 10 parts water. Apply with sponge, scrub gently, and rinse with clean water. Effective on grease and baked-on food residues.

PRODUCTS.name: Cif Stainless Steel Cleaner & Polish
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 7-8. Non-abrasive. Avoid contact with eyes.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Spray on stainless steel surface and buff with a soft dry cloth. Works best on vertical surfaces. Apply in the direction of the grain for best results.

PRODUCTS.name: Godrej Stainless Steel Cleaner
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 7-8. Non-abrasive formula. Avoid contact with wood surfaces.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Shake well before use. Spray on surface and wipe with a lint-free cloth. Leaves a protective layer against fingerprints and smudges.

PRODUCTS.name: Godrej Wood Floor Cleaner
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 6-7. pH-neutral formula safe for sealed wood. Avoid excessive water on wood surfaces.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Dilute 1 part with 40 parts water. Use with a damp mop (not wet). For spot cleaning, spray directly on a microfiber cloth. Do not use on unsealed wood.

PRODUCTS.name: Jyothy Labs Wood Furniture Polish
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Flammable. Keep away from heat and flame. Use in ventilated area. Avoid contact with eyes.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Shake well. Spray on soft cloth (not directly on furniture). Wipe onto wood surface following the grain. Buff to a shine. Suitable for all sealed wood furniture.

PRODUCTS.name: Dettol Hand Sanitizer
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Contains 70% alcohol. Flammable. Keep away from heat. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Apply small amount to palm and rub hands together covering all surfaces until dry. No rinsing required. Use in dispensers for high-traffic areas.

PRODUCTS.name: Savlon Hand Wash - Professional
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse with water.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Pump small amount onto wet hands. Lather for 20-30 seconds, covering all hand surfaces. Rinse thoroughly with water. Suitable for commercial dispensers.

PRODUCTS.name: Lifebuoy Antibacterial Hand Wash
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 5.5-6.5. Dermatologically tested. Avoid contact with eyes.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Dispense appropriate amount, lather for 20 seconds focusing on fingernails and between fingers. Rinse and dry with clean towel.

PRODUCTS.name: Lizol Bathroom Cleaner
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Contains acid. Corrosive. Wear gloves. Use in ventilated area. Avoid contact with eyes and skin.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Spray on bathroom surfaces including sinks, tiles, and shower areas. Let sit 2-3 minutes. Scrub with brush and rinse with water. Removes soap scum and hard water stains.

PRODUCTS.name: Godrej Bathroom Cleaner
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 2-3. Wear gloves. Avoid contact with eyes. Use in ventilated area.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Spray on bathroom surfaces. Let sit for 2 minutes. Scrub with a brush or sponge. Rinse thoroughly with water. Effective on soap scum and mildew.

PRODUCTS.name: Harpic Drain Cleaner
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Contains concentrated acid. Extremely corrosive. Wear protective gloves and goggles. Use in ventilated area. Do not mix with other chemicals.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Pour 250ml slowly into drain. Let it work for 15-30 minutes. Flush with plenty of hot water. For tough clogs, leave overnight. Avoid contact with skin and eyes.

PRODUCTS.name: Domex Drain Cleaner
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Contains alkaline formula. Corrosive. Wear gloves. Avoid contact with skin and eyes. Use in ventilated area.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Pour directly into drain. Allow to work for 10-15 minutes. Flush with hot water. Do not use with other drain products. Keep out of reach of children.

PRODUCTS.name: Diversey Industrial Degreaser
PRODUCTS.description: Industrial Degreaser - heavy duty professional grade
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 13-14. Highly alkaline. Wear protective gloves, goggles, and apron. Use in well-ventilated area. Corrosive to skin.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Dilute 1 part with 5 parts water for heavy grease. Apply with mop or scrubber. Let sit 5-10 minutes. Scrub and rinse with water. For extra heavy grease, use undiluted.

PRODUCTS.name: Jyothy Labs Heavy Duty Industrial Cleaner
PRODUCTS.description: Heavy Duty Industrial Cleaner - professional grade
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 12-13. Wear gloves and protective clothing. Use in ventilated area. Avoid skin contact.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Dilute 1 part with 10 parts water. Apply to industrial surfaces using mop or pressure washer. For heavy deposits, increase concentration to 1:5. Rinse thoroughly.

PRODUCTS.name: Colin Upholstery & Fabric Cleaner
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 8-9. Test on inconspicuous area first. Avoid over-wetting fabric. Use in ventilated area.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Dilute 1 part with 5 parts water. Apply using spray bottle or upholstery machine. Blot (don't scrub) with clean cloth. Allow to air dry completely.

PRODUCTS.name: Cif Oven & Grill Heavy Duty Cleaner
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 13-14. Highly alkaline. Wear gloves and goggles. Use in ventilated area. Avoid contact with aluminum surfaces.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Spray on cool oven surfaces. Let sit 10-15 minutes for baked-on grime. Wipe with damp cloth. For stubborn deposits, apply and leave overnight. Rinse thoroughly.

PRODUCTS.name: Dettol Floor Disinfectant Liquid
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Contains chloroxylenol. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Use in ventilated area. Keep sealed when not in use.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Dilute 1 part with 20 parts water. Mop floors thoroughly. No rinsing required. Effective against bacteria and viruses. Safe for use around children and pets when diluted.

PRODUCTS.name: Savlon Floor Disinfectant Cleaner
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 7-8. Mild formula. Avoid contact with eyes. Keep sealed.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Dilute 1 part with 40 parts water. Apply with mop. Leaves a protective antimicrobial layer. Suitable for daily use in high-traffic areas.

PRODUCTS.name: Odonil Air Freshener - Institutional
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Contains fragrance oils. Avoid contact with eyes. Keep sealed when not in use. Do not spray near open flame.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: For continuous fragrance, place automatic dispenser in high-traffic areas. For spot treatment, spray 2-3 times in the center of the room. Effective up to 8 hours.

PRODUCTS.name: Godrej aer Automatic Air Freshener
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Pressurized container. Do not expose to temperatures above 50°C. Keep away from children. Avoid direct inhalation.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Insert refill into automatic dispenser. Set frequency (5, 10, or 15 minutes). Place dispenser in central location 6-8 feet above floor. Lasts 30-45 days at medium setting.

PRODUCTS.name: Jyothy Labs Industrial Hand Scrub
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Contains pumice and cleaning agents. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Moisturizing formula.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Apply small amount to dry hands. Rub thoroughly to work in the scrub, especially on heavily soiled areas. Rinse with water and dry. Suitable for industrial and workshop use.

PRODUCTS.name: Colin Carpet Freshener & Deodorizer
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Keep sealed when not in use. Avoid contact with eyes. Do not inhale powder. Keep away from children.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Sprinkle evenly over carpet surface. Let sit for 15-20 minutes. Vacuum thoroughly. For tough odors, leave overnight before vacuuming. Suitable for all carpet types.

PRODUCTS.name: Diversey Glass Cleaner Concentrate
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 9-10. Contains ammonia. Use in ventilated area. Avoid contact with eyes. Do not use on tinted windows.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Dilute 1 part with 10 parts water in spray bottle. Spray on glass surface and wipe with microfiber cloth or squeegee. Streak-free finish. Cost-effective concentrate solution.

PRODUCTS.name: Dettol Hospital Grade Disinfectant
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Contains chloroxylenol 4.8%. For professional use. Wear gloves and mask. Use in ventilated area. Effective against MRSA, E. coli, and SARS-CoV-2.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Dilute 1 part with 10 parts water. Apply to hard non-porous surfaces using mop or cloth. Keep surface wet for 5 minutes for full disinfection. Allow to air dry. No rinsing required.

PRODUCTS.name: Godrej Leather Cleaner & Conditioner
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Flammable. Keep away from heat and flame. Use in ventilated area. Test on inconspicuous area before use.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Shake well. Apply small amount to a soft cloth. Gently rub into leather surface in circular motion. Buff with clean dry cloth. Suitable for leather furniture, car seats, and upholstery.

PRODUCTS.name: Cif Marble & Stone Cleaner
PRODUCTS.description: Marble & Stone cleaner - pH-neutral professional grade
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: pH level: 7-8. pH-neutral formula safe for natural stone. Do not use acidic or alkaline cleaners on marble. Use in ventilated area.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Dilute 1 part with 20 parts water. Use with damp mop on marble and stone surfaces. No rinsing required. Do not use on unsealed stone. Buff dry for best finish.

PRODUCTS.name: Domex Professional Odor Eliminator
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Contains enzymes. Keep sealed when not in use. Avoid contact with eyes. Not for use on skin.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Spray directly on odor source or in the air. For carpet odors, saturate area lightly and allow to dry. For drain odors, pour 200ml down drain before leaving for the day.

PRODUCTS.name: Godrej Fabric & Linen Freshener
PRODUCTS.safety_notes: Contains fragrance oils. Avoid contact with eyes. Test on inconspicuous area first. Keep sealed when not in use.
PRODUCTS.usage_guidance: Spray lightly on curtains, upholstery, linens, and carpets from 12 inches away. For guest rooms, spray on linens before making beds. Refreshes fabrics between professional cleanings.
